programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Alex struggles with quarantining and his relationship with Donna, Tatti heads to Long Island to check on her family, and Krystal performs at Ted's showcase.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: As the crew gets ready to return to New York, Ceaser plans a final party in Atlanta and stuns Suzette when he gets down on one knee. Walt goes to extreme lengths to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: In the season premiere, the crew celebrates 10 years of Black Ink. The first ever Black Ink graduation ceremony goes left when Ceaser realizes that not everyone deserves to be head of the class.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: After Ceaser's talk with Ted and Puma, it's time for him to take on the other problem child. While Puma continues to handle things at home, Quani tries to find her independence and herself.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Spyder worries that his first pop-up shop will be a flop as Tatti looks to Krystal and Bae for advice on a special assignment. The Black Ink Bosses finally reunite after their heated confrontation.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Ceaser makes a public announcement about changes at the shop that could have a chilling effect on Rok and Krystal. Tatti gets a cold lesson in humility from Bae while deciding to take some personal matters into her own hands.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Attitudes fly, and feats of strength are tested when the members of 9MAG and 2nd City Ink attend a team bonding trip hosted by Ryan, who wants to rectify the last family dinner disaster. Meanwhile, not everyone wants to play on Charmaine's team.
programme.sub-title: Did You Make That Comment About Charmaine?

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Tempers flare as old beefs resurface at Char's new product launch. Nina and Phor work to put Phorever first, and Prince struggles with a choice offered and a choice made.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: With more and more artists joining 9MAG, Ryan comes back as focused as ever on his growing shop. Charmaine cleans house at 2nd City and implements new restrictions that leave the crew at 9MAG wondering "What's going on with Charmaine?"
programme.sub-title: Welcome to the World of Being Seen

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Don and Phor worry that Ryan might see their growth outside of the shop as disloyalty. As Draya settles into 9MAG, she finds out you can't run from all of your problems. Shogun throws a party to welcome all the new artists.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Ryan confronts his grandmother's passing and realizes he's been spread too thin between work and family. As several mysterious encounters with the ghost of 9MAG start to worry the crew, Draya invites a medium to the shop to clear the air.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: After a long drought on the dating front, Don schemes to get Ryan on track to having a love life. Prince struggles to get through to his nephew, and enlists the help of "Sensei" Shogun.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Change is in the air at Black Ink as Ceaser introduces some new blood to the crew. Rok and Krystal consider their future at Black Ink as Bux opens up to bring awareness to others with his lifelong battle.
programme.sub-title: Guess Who's Coming To Black Ink?

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Ceaser is forced to make a hard decision about 125th. Bux gets an unexpected visit at the shop that rocks his world and his friendship. Alex holds auditions for his OnlyFans and is blown away by their talents.
programme.sub-title: Black Ink & Harlem Are Like PB&J

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Chaos ensues when the 125th artists merge with the Brooklyn shop. A startling revelation about Rok causes Ted and Puma to panic. Bux makes the situation with Spyder worse. Ceaser announces an out-of-town trip and Tatti goes MIA.
programme.sub-title: So Much For A Mental Health Day

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Determined to correct the dreadful literature that Wednesday and Pugsley are exposed to, Morticia sets out to create a new literary world. Gomez fears that his wife's first manuscript is so good, that once the publisher reads it he will lose her.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: There is a neighborhood burglar on the loose, and Morticia has reason to believe it could be Gomez. Morticia decides to probe his subconscious mind for a key to his criminality after she and Uncle Fester discover loot hidden in the storeroom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's pet plant Cleopatra gobbles up her favorite photo of Gomez from the family album. When the original photographer is found and asked to make a duplicate picture, it is discovered that he is now with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Fester is so smitten upon receipt of a photo of his love, a bearded carnival lady, that he borrows stamp money to mail her a proposal. Morticia dons a beard and poses as the mother to convince Fester that he will have to work to support a wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Because she thinks Fester (Jackie Coogan) and Grandmama (Blossom Rock) are spoiling the children, Morticia (Carolyn Jones) hires a governess. Insulted, Fester paints a white line down the center of the Addams house, dividing it in half.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley shocks his parents when he gives up his new atomic reactor as kid stuff and announces that he wants to find his own job. His first try is as a medical assistant to Dr. Bird. He turns up, scalpel in hand, ready to help during an operation.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia, in order to be part of the National Beautification Program, decides to become a home decorator and offers her services to the neighbors. Next door neighbor, and insurance agent, Joe Digby hires Morticia in hopes of selling them insurance.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia taunts Uncle Fester into announcing that he is going to join the Peace Corps. Fester feels he's a cinch to be accepted because Gomez plans to pull strings in Washington on his behalf. The entire family agrees to help him study for the exam.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Allyn Joslyn guest-stars as Sam Hilliard, a former truant officer who now heads a private school where Wednesday and Pugsley are enrolled. When Hilliard breaks under the strain of dealing with the Addams children, Gomez buys the school.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's concern that Lurch is overworked leads Gomez to the operating table to assemble a custom-built secondary butler. Lurch lets the robot do all the work and then begins to feel that he isn't needed anymore.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia calls a psychiatrist after she fears Pugsley is becoming normal after he abandons his pet octopus for a puppy and is seen wearing a Boy Scout uniform, playing with a baseball bat, and helping an old lady cross the street.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Uncle Fester, who has become lonely, convinces Gomez and Morticia that it is time for him to find a bride. He decides to put an ad in the newspaper, looking for love. But things go awry when a door-to-door saleswoman comes by.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Lionel Barker, a former suitor of Morticia's, shows up, Gomez is jealous. But he's soon calmed when he learns that Barker is after Mildred, the new maid. The Addamses then discover that Barker is a con man--after Mildred's money, not her love.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The family faces a crisis when Wednesday packs her spider and runs away (after being scolded for playing with Uncle Fester's TNT). When they try to file a missing person report, a detective is anxious to retire early due to their story.

programme.title: World's Most Evil Killers
programme.desc: Richard Trenton Chase was an American serial killer who brutally murdered six people within a month in the late 70s in California. Chase was given the nickname The Vampire of Sacramento.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: When 2 best friends take a Kayaking trip, they are hoping for nothing less than a great adventure. Powerful currents and bad weather quickly expose how one is inexperienced and both, in grave danger.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: Dave Ruvola and his 4 man helicopter rescue crew are called upon to help save a yachtsman shipwrecked.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: A conservationist survives an airplane crash in Zimbabwe. Suffering severe injuries Greg must do everything he can to survive until help arrives.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Radioactive Rocks
programme.desc: A dialysis patient is bleeding and doctors can't get it to stop: a naked man falls into a cactus and is covered head to toe in cactus needles; a patient brings radioactive rocks to the hospital causing chaos in the ER.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Why Am I Blue?
programme.desc: A man arrives in the ER with blue skin and the doctor has no idea what's causing it; a teenage girl has abdominal pains that doctors have been unable to diagnose for years; a doctor struggles to save the life of the only survivor of a plane crash.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: My Job Is Mayhem
programme.desc: A man injured in a medieval roleplaying battle has a sword impaled in his head; a critically ill patient is so afraid of germs he won't allow doctors to treat him; two patients with the same life-threatening symptoms arrive separately from a fashion show.

programme.title: Killer Mysteries
programme.desc: When a chef’s wife goes missing from Southern California, it initially appears she may have voluntarily walked away from the life she knew.

programme.title: Killer Mysteries
programme.desc: The discovery of a Jane Doe underneath a New Jersey bridge kick starts an intensive investigation to figure out who she is and how she died.

programme.title: Killer Mysteries
programme.desc: Police investigate the murder of a husband and his pregnant wife.

programme.title: Killer Mysteries
programme.desc: When a young man is murdered in his home, the only suspect with a motive is his ex-girlfriend, who claims she hasn’t seen the victim for months.

programme.title: I Lived with a Killer
programme.desc: Sammy "The Bull" Gravano's testimony against the Mafia affected the life of his daughter, Karen.

programme.title: I Lived with a Killer
programme.desc: Small-town police officer Drew Peterson becomes a media sensation after his wife goes missing.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: Authorities respond to a fire, only to find Carolyn Casey’s body at the center of the blaze. With little evidence and no witnesses, Dr. G must find the cause of death to catch her killer.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: Jeffrey Ortiz, a mentally challenged man with the mental capacity of a nine-year-old, is making himself a sandwich when he inexplicably falls, striking his head on the kitchen counter.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: Eugenie Ademola is loving her new life in the US when she dies unexpectedly. It’s up to Dr. G to bring closure to Eugenie’s family, but the autopsy results are shocking.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: In temperatures exceeding 100 degrees and with no food or water, Ken faces a desperate fight for his life.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: Lifelong friends Joseph Rangel and Lorenzo Madrid sign up for a five-day sport fishing trip.
programme.sub-title: Death in the Sea of Cortez

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: On a short "jeep" adventure, disaster strikes when the jeep hits a large rock, causing it to roll.

programme.title: Control total
programme.desc: Shia LaBeouf y Michelle Monaghan protagonizan esta historia como dos extraños que tratan de escapar del peligro, cuando son arrancados de sus vidas normales y 'activados' en un complot de asesinado de alta tecnología.

programme.title: El mensajero
programme.desc: El ganador del Oscar Gary Oldman y Olga Kurylenko protagonizan un thriller de acción sobre una mensajera que pelea contra los secuaces de un jefe criminal sádico para proteger al único testigo capaz de hundirlo.

programme.title: Jack Ryan: código sombra
programme.desc: El suspenso no se detiene mientras el recluta de la CIA Ryan queda atrapado en una peligrosa red de intriga y espionaje. Ryan debe pasar de soldado a analista a agente operativo para detener un complot terrorista devastador contra EE. UU.

programme.title: Resultado final
programme.desc: Después de que terroristas mortales secuestran a su sobrina en un partido de fútbol, un ex soldado con habilidades de combate letales (Dave Bautista) libra una guerra de un solo hombre para salvarla y evitar la destrucción masiva.

programme.title: Mátalos suavemente
programme.desc: Durante la crisis económica de 2008, Jackie Cogan (Brad Pitt), un sicario, es contratado para restablecer el orden después de que tres idiotas roban una partida de póquer protegida por la mafia.

programme.title: Ronin (ESP)
programme.desc: Un equipo de agentes especiales internacionales debe llevar a cabo una misión misteriosa: robar un maletín fuertemente custodiado buscado tanto por el IRA como por la mafia rusa.

programme.title: Revancha
programme.desc: Tras un exitoso atraco, Porter es dado por muerto. Una vez recuperado, busca venganza y quiere su parte del dinero.

programme.title: La estafa maestra
programme.desc: Tras ser traicionados y abandonados a su suerte en Italia, Charlie Croker y su equipo planean un elaborado robo de oro contra su antiguo aliado.

programme.title: Dahmer (ESP)
programme.desc: Jeffrey Dahmer (Jeremy Renner, Zona de miedo) fue vilipendiado cuando las autoridades descubrieron que había asesinado, desmembrado e incluso tratado de consumir los cuerpos de 15 jóvenes en Milwaukee.

programme.title: Nunca Digas Su Nombre

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Batman vs. The Penguin
programme.desc: Murph gets Oscar to agree to participate in a regular TV segment where he competes with a penguin at the zoo to predict the winners of hockey games.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: The God Couple
programme.desc: Oscar grumbles when Felix helps Dani prepare for a choir solo and encourages the group to attend church to support her.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Conscious Odd Coupling
programme.desc: After a heated argument, Oscar and Felix decide it might be best to change their living arrangement and find new roommates.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Pilot
programme.desc: Oscar Madison reluctantly agrees to let Felix Unger, his uptight former college roommate, move in with him after both of their marriages fail.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: The Ghostwriter
programme.desc: When Oscar is hired to ghostwrite the autobiography of a retired baseball player, Felix offers his "help" by advising Murph to go in a different direction, making Oscar's job more difficult. Geoff Stults guest stars.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: The Birthday Party
programme.desc: When Oscar realizes he's forgotten Felix's birthday, he pulls together a last-minute surprise party in his honor in an attempt to impress Casey. Dwight Howard guest stars.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: The Blind Leading The Blind Date
programme.desc: When Dani reveals she's depressed that she'll be the only single one at her high school reunion, Oscar and Felix each put their distinctive dating strategies to work to help her find a boyfriend.
programme.sub-title: The Blind Leading The Blind Date

programme.title: The Odd Couple: The Wedding Deception
programme.desc: When Oscar and Felix attend the wedding of an old college friend, Oscar aims to reconnect with an old flame while Felix is determined to show his ex-wife (guest star Christine Woods) that he's a changed man.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Heal Thyself
programme.desc: Felix's hypochondria kicks into overdrive when Oscar starts dating the most important person in Felix's life - his doctor. Erinn Hayes guest stars as Sharon.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Secret Agent Man
programme.desc: Felix convinces Oscar to appear on a sports television show against Teddy's advice to stick with radio. NFL Network's Rich Eisen and 'Inside the NBA on TNT's' Kenny Smith guest star as themselves.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: The Unger Games
programme.desc: When Oscar feels threatened by Felix's surprising performance on the softball field and basketball court, they agree to a decathlon to determine which one of them is the better athlete. Geoff Stults guest stars.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Sleeping Dogs Lie
programme.desc: When Oscar and Felix make a trip to Ashley's (Christine Woods) to retrieve Felix's special pillow, a secret that he has kept from Oscar is revealed. Five-time NBA All-Star Chris Webber guest stars.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Enlightening Strikes
programme.desc: When Felix substitute teaches a yoga class, his teaching style rubs everyone, including Emily, the wrong way. Weird Al Yankovic and Regis Philbin guest star.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Jealous Island
programme.desc: Oscar becomes obsessed with living up to Murph's (Geoff Stults) standards when he finds out the girl he is seeing used to date the handsome ex-baseball player.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: The Audit Couple
programme.desc: When the IRS decides to audit Oscar and his ex-wife Gaby, Felix offers to mediate between the contentious exes when he realizes that he might be the reason Oscar was audited in the first place.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: All About Eavesdropping
programme.desc: After Oscar and Felix become obsessed with eavesdropping on their bickering neighbors, they try to subtly intervene and help them save their marriage.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Unger The Influence
programme.desc: With the help of Murph, Oscar decides to throw a big party when Felix finally agrees to spend the weekend away. Also, Felix and Emily have their first sleepover.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: From Here to Maturity
programme.desc: Oscar faces a personal dilemma when he dates a young nanny, Allyson (Brianne Howey) who works for his neighbor, Charlotte (Teri Hatcher).

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Madison & Son
programme.desc: Oscar's dream comes true when he is asked to throw out the first pitch at a New York Mets game.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Oscar's Overture
programme.desc: Oscar attempts to impress Charlotte (Teri Hatcher) by purchasing a table for a fundraiser to benefit The New York Philharmonic.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: An Oscar Named Desire
programme.desc: Oscar and Charlotte hit a speed bump when they hesitate to take their relationship to the next level.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Make Room For Dani
programme.desc: Oscar reluctantly agrees with his agent that it's time to shake things up on his radio show and allows Dani to have a bigger role after a rival host, Rich Eisen, taunts him.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: A Dinner Engagement
programme.desc: Felix attempts to reverse Emily's birthday curse and plans a nice dinner to celebrate with friends.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Chess Nuts
programme.desc: Oscar learns that Felix was a nationally ranked chess player as a child and convinces him to return to the game to make money.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Odd Man Out
programme.desc: Felix forces Oscar and Emily to go on a date to get to know each other better in the hope that they'll become friends.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Road Scholar
programme.desc: In an attempt to surprise Emily, Felix gets his learner's permit and enlists his friends to help him learn how to drive.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: All The Residents' Men
programme.desc: Oscar and Felix run a heated campaign for President of their building's tenants' association, but Oscar doesn't fully realize everything the position entails.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: The Ex-Factor
programme.desc: When Murph persuades Oscar to try online dating, Oscar finds himself on a blind date with Felix's ex-wife, Ashley (Christine Woods).

programme.title: The Odd Couple: London Calling
programme.desc: Oscar is forced to choose between his romantic plans with Charlotte (Teri Hatcher) and helping to save Felix's relationship as Emily decides to extend her stay in London.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Food Fight
programme.desc: When Oscar learns that his favorite hangout, Langford's, is in financial trouble, he impulsively asks Felix to help save it, without considering the disastrous consequences.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: I Kid, You Not
programme.desc: Oscar tries to prove to Charlotte that he can be responsible when he volunteers to take her son, Evan (Caleb Brown), trick-or-treating on Halloween.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Taffy Days
programme.desc: Oscar reconnects with many significant people from his father's life when he agrees to carry out Walter's last request to spread his ashes behind the candy factory he once owned.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Miss England
programme.desc: Dani's excitement at being promoted is cut short when Oscar tasks her with the daunting job of hiring her own replacement.

programme.title: The Odd Couple: Eisen Trouble
programme.desc: Oscar tries to outsmart his nemesis, Rich Eisen, after he is forced to present him with a humanitarian award.

programme.title: Copycat Killers
programme.desc: Morgan Geyser and Anissa Weier attempt to kill a classmate, inspired by Slender Man.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: John Myatt and John Drew – The Art World Con
programme.desc: The pair pulled off the biggest art con of the 20th Century, passing off works painted by Myatt as genuine works by famous artists.
programme.sub-title: John Myatt and John Drew – The Art World Con

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Robert Hendy-Freegard – The Terrorist Trickster
programme.desc: Dubbed “The Most Evil Conman Ever” by the British press, Hendy-Freegard terrorized victims into believing they were terrorist targets.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: The Conman Kid – Aged Just 13
programme.desc: This 13-year-old pulled off almost half a million dollars worth of fraud, often selling goods that didn’t exist.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Gene Morrison – Fraudulent Forensics Expert
programme.desc: He faked his own credentials and netted $400,000 of taxpayers money, giving bogus court testimony and investigative services.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Carl Hildebrandt – The Dead Con Artist
programme.desc: Hildebrandt faked his own death and stole the identity of a dead child to escape criminal charges before fleeing to Florida.
programme.sub-title: Carl Hildebrandt – The Dead Con Artist

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Robert Hyams – The Suspect Scientist
programme.desc: Hyams posed as a leading scientist and millionaire art buyer before fleeing to California where he posed as a leading academic.

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Paul Bint – The Chameleon Con Artist
programme.desc: Dubbed the British Frank Abagnale, Bint committed more than 500 offences including impersonating people.
programme.sub-title: Paul Bint – The Chameleon Con Artist

programme.title: Conmen Case Files: Glenn Rycroft – The Cancer Con Artist
programme.desc: The former air steward who faked cancer and raised hundreds of thousands of dollars from his local community.
programme.sub-title: Glenn Rycroft – The Cancer Con Artist

programme.title: 72 Hours: Loch Ness Monster
programme.desc: In 1998, in a normally peaceful suburb, a pervert on a bicycle appears, performing sexual acts on himself and then attacking teenage girls. For reasons apparent to the residents, they nickname him after the Scottish Loch Ness monster.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Mad Bomber
programme.desc: In 1996 a serial bomber begins planting bombs in public places and terrorizes the Prince Edward Island community. The mystery person leaves a strange swastika as a calling card, eluding capture for eight years.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Bull's Eye
programme.desc: A Girl Guide leader is found dead on the floor of her bedroom. When an autopsy reveals a bullet lodged in her brain, detectives learn they’re investigating a murder.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Who Killed Santa?
programme.desc: In 2001, there are a series of murders of homeless people in Toronto. The latest killing is of a gentle man, well known in the area by residents who nicknamed him Santa Claus.

programme.title: 72 Hours: Danger in the Woods
programme.desc: Three teenagers accompany a deliveryman to a densely wooded area for a drinking party that, before long, becomes a nightmare. Things take a terrifying turn when one of teens attacks the others.

programme.title: 72 Hours: The Saint
programme.desc: A frat boy lures a girl to his house with the promise of a party, but once there it turns out he has ulterior motives. When the girl says no, he violently attacks her. A string of violence is finally uncovered, revealing a sinister trail of violence.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)
programme.desc: On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato.
programme.sub-title: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Jean-Jacques Le Page Case
programme.desc: On the morning of July 24th 2009, a fire erupts at house in Plougonvelin.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Murderous Lovers - Anne Bardot
programme.desc: The disturbing missing case in Paris of 4 years old.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Mysterious Disappearences in Paris - Christelle Leroy
programme.desc: On March 21th 1991, Pascale Escarfail, 19 years old, is discovered dead at her studio in the 14th arrondissement of Paris, she was raped then stabbed multiple times.
programme.sub-title: Mysterious Disappearences in Paris - Christelle Leroy

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Very Strange Suicide (Muller case)
programme.desc: Police in Strasbourg receive a startling emergency call from Doctor Jean-Louis Muller, a forensic pathologist well known in the region.

programme.title: The Substitute 4: Failure Is Not an Option
programme.desc: An undercover policeman infiltrates a military school's faculty to put a stop to the actions of white supremacists.

programme.title: The Substitute
programme.desc: A soldier of fortune (Tom Berenger) fills in for an injured teacher (Diane Venora) in a high school where gangs rule and the principal (Ernie Hudson) has a piece of the action.

programme.title: The Substitute 2: School's Out
programme.desc: To avenge his brother's death, a mercenary works undercover as a teacher at a tough high school.

programme.title: The Substitute 3: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: A former mercenary (Treat Williams) becomes an undercover professor as he tries to track down the person who attacked an old Army buddy's daughter.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Chris and Andy face a tough decision while investigating a vicious beating; Sam and Luke get competitive during a retraining exercise.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: 15 Division starts a city-wide search for an abducted 9-year-old girl; disturbing evidence is uncovered during an interrogation.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: An inmate escapes during a prisoner transport; Gail and Dov try to help a man with amnesia; Traci and Chris help reconstruct notes missing from a court case.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy faces the possibility that her father may have murdered someone during a drunken blackout; Chris and Dov's squad car is robbed.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy questions her future with the force after the suspicious death of a young girl; the rookies find out if they have passed their evaluations.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: An untimely arrest compromises a major drug bust; Andy goes undercover with Swarek; Dov must choose between his girlfriend and his career.

programme.title: Rookie Blue
programme.desc: Andy butts heads with Division 15's new detective when they both investigate a shooting at a concert.

programme.title: Barb & Star Go to Vista Del Mar
programme.desc: Lifelong friends Barb and Star embark on the adventure of a lifetime when they decide to leave their small Midwestern town for the first time ever.

programme.title: Delivery Man
programme.desc: An amiable slacker (Vince Vaughn) discovers that the anonymous sperm donations he made to a fertility clinic 20 years ago resulted in 533 offspring and that 142 of them have now filed a lawsuit to learn his identity.

programme.title: They Came Together
programme.desc: The owner (Amy Poehler) of an independent candy shop and the corporate stooge (Paul Rudd) who has been sent to shut her down begin an unlikely romance.

programme.title: South Park: D-Yikes!
programme.desc: D-Yikes!: Ms. Garrison decides that she is a lesbian after getting dumped again but hell breaks loose when her new favourite lesbian bar faces a takeover from Persians in a '300' stylee. (S11, E06)

programme.title: South Park: Night of the Living Homeless
programme.desc: Night of the Living Homeless: When a plague of homeless people hits South Park, the boys devise a plan to move them on whilst the adults panic like they're in a zombie movie. (S11, E07)

programme.title: South Park: Le Petite Tourette
programme.desc: Le Petite Tourette: Cartman experiences bliss when he discovers that, by pretending to have Tourettes, he can say whatever he likes to whoever he likes! Naturally, national TV beckons. (S11, E08)

programme.title: South Park: More Cr*p
programme.desc: More Cr*p: Inadvertently, Randy breaks the world record for the 'biggest cr*p'! Bono, the previous holder, is determined to regain his crown - but he has a dark secret which may stop him. (S11, E09)

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland: Episode I
programme.desc: Imaginationland - Episode I: The boys find themselves in a magical land where all of the world's imagination is laid out before them. (S11, E10)

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland: Episode II
programme.desc: Imaginationland - Episode II: The government are holding Stan and Kyle captive, to find out how they got into Imaginationland. Butters is in trouble with evil creatures like Snarf! (S11, E11)

programme.title: South Park: Imaginationland: Episode III
programme.desc: Imaginationland- Episode III: Stan and Butters are stuck in Imaginationland fighting for their lives, while Cartman goes all the way to the supreme court to get Kyle to pay up on their bet. (S11, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Guitar Queer-O
programme.desc: Guitar Queer-o: Stan and Kyle are set to hit big time with their skills on computer game Guitar Hero. Their manager convinces Stan that Kyle is holding him back. Will the "band" break up? (S11, E13)

programme.title: South Park: The List
programme.desc: The List: The boys steal a list from the girls which rates their looks from the cutest to the ugliest. Spirits plummet, while for others egos inflate! Can the ghost of Abraham Lincoln help? (S11, E14)

programme.title: South Park: Tonsil Trouble
programme.desc: Tonsil Trouble: A botched blood transfusion results in Cartman getting AIDS. How far will he go to find a cure? Kyle had better watch out... (S12, E01)

programme.title: South Park: Britney's New Look
programme.desc: Britney's New Look: The media circus arrives in South Park as Britney Spears hides in the town. After a photo of her urinating on a ladybug sells for $100,000 the boys have a brain wave. (S12, E02)

programme.title: South Park: Major B**bage
programme.desc: Major B**bage: The hysterical parents of South Park have another reason to panic after 'cheesing' becomes popular among kids. Kenny becomes addicted to the out-of-this-world hallucinations. (S12, E03)

programme.title: South Park: Canada on Strike
programme.desc: Canada on Strike: Canada is brought to the brink of collapse after a drawn out strike in pursuit of 'some of that internet money'. Can the boys save the day with a "YouToob" sensation? (S12, E04)

programme.title: True Justice
programme.desc: Kane, dealing with his own post war stress must help a war comrade suffering from P.T.S. who becomes a sniper terrorist suspect.

programme.title: The Border
programme.desc: A U.S. rendition flight crash-lands in rural Quebec, and ICS must recapture three terrorists before the Americans forcibly intervene.

programme.title: The Border
programme.desc: ICS Director Kessler and U.S. Agent LaGarda clash with disgruntled ex-Airborne soldiers and an elusive arms dealer while hunting for stolen military weapons.

programme.title: The Border
programme.desc: Major Kessler releases an illegal Russian stripper as a political favour, sparking a scandal that climaxes in murder.

programme.title: The Border
programme.desc: When Gray and Layla bust a human-trafficking operation, they follow a grisly trail to an old adversary.

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programme.desc: A brutal motorcycle gang murder takes place in a biker bar.

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programme.desc: A cache of missing chips from a closed down casino turn up in Vegas and a string of murders follow, leading Langston to use deadly force for the first time in his career as a CSI.

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programme.desc: While Grissom leads a group of college students on a tour of CSI, the dead speak while the CSIs investigate, each narrating their own case

programme.title: NEW CSI: Crime Scene Investigation
programme.desc: The CSIs investigate first-hand the behind-the-scenes action of Cirque du Soleil in order to determine what may have contributed to a young dancer's untimely death.

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Perfect Family
programme.desc: Andy’s ideas about what makes a perfect family are put into perspective when she meets an out-of-control teen who needs to be protected from her own conservative family.

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Uprising
programme.desc: A riot breaks out at a women’s correctional institute while Andy, Juliet, Nick, and Gail are there to transfer prisoners. They end up in a lock-down situation that finds Andy and Juliet trapped with a woman desperate to prove her innocence

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Letting Go
programme.desc: When Nick’s estranged older brother emerges with new information on someone from their tragic past, Nick goes off the grid to track the man down. But Juliet is hot on his heels, and Nick is forced to let her into the secrets of his past.

programme.title: Rookie Blue: A Real Gentleman
programme.desc: When Traci is a no-show for her first raid, 15 Division fears the notorious gun dealer they’re after has kidnapped her. But when Andy realizes that the serial rapist we never caught is back, it’s all hands on deck to find Traci

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Home Run
programme.desc: After a community-outreach baseball game erupts in a drive-by shooting, Gail’s relationship with her brother is put to the test . Meanwhile, Swarek plans a getaway with Andy up to Oliver’s cabin, which goes off the rails in every possible way

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Best Man
programme.desc: Andy and Sam are shocked to learn that Oliver is the prime suspect in IA’s corruption investigation into 15 Division. They only have until end of day today to find Chris Klem – the missing explosives-dealer – and clear Oliver’s name

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Integrity Test
programme.desc: With Oliver still the prime suspect in the bombing of 15’s evidence room, Andy, Dov, Gail, and Nick undertake a risky – and potentially career-ending – plan to prove that Commissioner Alonso Santana is corrupt.

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Ninety Degrees
programme.desc: Andy heads out with a very-pregnant Marlo to find a volatile woman who’s gone missing after group therapy, but neither Andy nor Marlo are prepared when Marlo suddenly goes into labor.

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Breaking Up the Band
programme.desc: Now that Sam and Marlo’s baby girl has arrived (Ep. 520), it’s clear nothing could have prepared Andy for this moment. So when Juliet offers Andy an opportunity to leave town for 4 months on an undercover project, Andy starts to consider it.

programme.title: Rookie Blue: 74 Epiphanies
programme.desc: Andy and Sam’s wedding comes just in time for the gang to celebrate one last hurrah. But when Andy is taken off-course by a hitchhiker and then stranded on the side of a dead-end road with a dying man, she finds herself with no way to get help

programme.title: Rookie Blue: Fresh Paint
programme.desc: Andy McNally’s first shift on the job turns into mayhem when shots are fired in a downtown rooming house. In the midst of the chaos, Andy triumphantly makes her first big arrest

programme.title: No Estamos Solos

programme.title: El Ilusionista

programme.title: No Dispare

programme.title: Obsesión

programme.desc: Hay un demonio suelto en una casa de Connecticut, y un niño de 12 años se lleva la peor parte de su ira. Él ve a un anciano con pezuñas y cuernos, lo golpean y lo arrojan y finalmente es poseído. Solo un exorcismo salvará su alma.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Se ha dicho que cada fotografía roba una parte del alma de un hombre. Entonces, ¿qué ocurre con todas esas partes cuando la persona ya ha fallecido?

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Los niños a menudo se encuentran a merced del mundo de los adultos y, algunas veces, se sienten incapaces de influir en el curso de sus propias existencias.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: En la inocencia de la infancia, el miedo es perfecto, y no resulta influenciado por la racionalidad adulta, lo cual supone que se puede comprender a cabalidad el mundo que nos rodea.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Algunas personas creen que todo nuestro conocimiento del mundo nos llega a través de la percepción sensorial y los poderes del razonamiento. Otras, en cambio, piensan que podemos obtener conocimiento por medio de la intuición.

programme.title: Arriba Las Manos Texano
programme.desc: El texano, hijo de Manuel Saldivar, un asesino cruel y desalmado, emprende un viaje para llegar al rancho de Joe Pastrana. Al llegar se entera por su hija, que Joe a muerto victima de una balacera comandada por Jim, un cruel hombre.

programme.title: Aventuras Del Látigo Negro: El Misterio del Látigo Negro
programme.desc: Con la misma moneda: en el pueblo de San Fernando, el comisario don Miguel, su hija Rosita y Julian, novio de ella, reciben a Roberto, que llega con su hermana enferma Laura Elena y que desea adquirir tierras del lugar.

programme.title: Aventuras Del Látigo Negro: La Marca del Gavilán
programme.desc: La marca del gavilan: en San Fernand, los compadres Manuel y Jose, sicarios del gavilan, asesinan por equivocacion al viudo Pablo, padre de un bebe a quien llama su tesoro: eso le cuesta la vida.

programme.title: Aventuras Del Látigo Negro: El Látigo Negro Contra los Farsantes
programme.desc: El farsante: mientras Julián está en la capital comprando ganado, para disgusto de su novia Rosita, sin saber que llega a San Fernando Rogelio, un rico hacendado.

programme.title: Aventuras Del Látigo Negro: La Muerte Pasa Lista
programme.desc: Misteriosas muertes de personas y robos de ganado, llevan al latigo negro a investigar quien esta detras de todo esto, los pueblerinos de San Fernando no se sienten a gusto, en la comisaria no hacen nada por temor a que tambien les hagan algo.

programme.title: Ay Chabela
programme.desc: Jose Francisco, Luciano y Chabela desde la infancia fueron inseparables amigos. Pero el destino ha decidido separarlos ya que los padres de José han decido que su hijo estudie en un colegio en los estados unidos.

programme.title: Cada Oveja Con Su Pareja
programme.desc: Leonor y Rosa son dos hermanas que se han dedicado a tratar de ganar los corazones de dos jóvenes charros Ángel y Pepe; es por ello que solicitan el apoyo del padrino de estos, don Manuel.

programme.title: Chucho El Roto
programme.desc: Jesus Arriaga, mejor conocido como chucho el roto, es un simple y honesto carpintero que ofrece sus servicios en la casa de la familia De Frizac, sin imaginar que se enamoraria de Matilde, la hija del dueño de tan lujosa mansion donde trabaja.

programme.title: Cuando Habla El Corazon
programme.desc: Historia que demuestra la amistad entre dos amigos, que a lo largo de los años se demuestran que hay que ser valientes y leales. Tratando de defender a su amada, pero también a la fiel a la amistad que se deben.

programme.title: El Enmascarado de Plata
programme.desc: El médico, un enmascarado cuyo fin es defender a los desprotegidos, se convierte en un hábil luchador capaz de hacer frente a los delincuentes más peligrosos, pues siguiendo los pasos de su padre, un verdadero hombre de ciencia.

programme.title: El Pueblo Fantasma
programme.desc: Manuel Saldívar el texano llega a un pueblo dominado por un pistolero llamado Rio Kid, que le revela que su progenitor era un asesino. El texano decide limpiar su nombre haciendo el bien.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El impacto es mundial cuando los visitantes regresan a South Park y los chicos descubren que la Tierra es un enorme reality show intergaláctico.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La verdadera "Jenny from the block" se enfurece cuando una de las partes del cuerpo de Cartman se hace demasiado famosa por sus propios medios.
programme.sub-title: Culo gordo y cabeza de panqueuqe

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos juegan a ser detectives y realizan un buen trabajo resolvendo pequeños misterios locales. Tanto así que la policía los llama para felicitarlos y darles casos verdaderos y peligrosos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Obligados a salir de su tierra por los propietarios del "Casino Indio Tres Plumas", los chicos organizan a South Park para pelear contra los ricos y poderosos Indios.
programme.sub-title: La codicia del hombre de piel roja

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos son candidatos para ser gays una vez que la locura metrosexual llega a South Park, y el señor Garrison acusa a los chicos de "Queer eye" de venderse.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman llega a los mejores lugares de las listas de éxitos con su propia banda cristiana de rock, y los chicos son arrestados por bajar música de internet.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Después de que algunos ciudadanos adultos de South Park acribillan algunos mercados de granjeros, los chicos deciden tomar acción contra la generación más vieja.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuando Kyle elige invitar a Butters en lugar de Cartman en un viaje de cumpleaños, Cartman convenientemente "desaparece" a Butters.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cuando un chico mormón se muda a South Park, Stan tiene que patear su trasero, mientras el resto de los ciudadanos están fascinados y se convierten en mormones.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos van a un restaurante famoso por sus deliciosas alitas y por tener meseras bellas. Butters piensa que ha encontrado a la chica de sus sueños.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La familia Broflovski celebra Hanukkah juntos cuando una pareja canadiense, que se presentan como Harry y Gints Elise, van a su casa.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Después de comprar armas de artes marciales del lejano oriente en un mercado de pulgas local, los chicos se transforman en ninjas.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman se disfraza de robot y le hace creer a Butters que es enviado desde Japón. Pero su broma se termina cuando descubre que Butters tiene un vídeo de él disfrazado de Britney Spears que quiere mostrar en la escuela.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Jimmy y Timmy entrenan para participar en las Olimpiadas Especiales y Jimmy acepta esteroides que le ofrece Nathan. Mientras, Cartman se disfraza para convencer a un comité calificado de que él es discapacitado y así ganar el premio.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman convence a Kyle de que vea "La Pasión", la nueva película de Mel Gibson que según Cartman demuestra por qué todo el mundo odia a los judíos. Kyle la mira y tiene una especie de revelación que lo lleva a disculparse con Cartman.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos son desafiados por un grupo de jóvenes bailarines de breakdance, y Stan decide armar un grupo de baile para ganarles.

programme.desc: Humanos del año 3045 están llegando a South Park a través de un portal del tiempo y buscan trabajo. Cuando los chicos tratan de ganar dinero extra, los inmigrantes del tiempo les quitan trabajo a todos.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Un Wall-Mart gigante llega a South Park y atrae a los habitantes por sus increíbles ofertas. Cartman queda poseído por sus bajos precios. Stan y Kyle buscan la manera de acabar con eso.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Por cinco años, los chicos han guardado un secreto sobre un incidente que cometieron en preescolar, por el cual Trent Boyett, un matón que los molestaba, fue a parar a un reformatorio. Pero ahora, Boyett está en libertad y quiere vengarse.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos de South Park producen sus propias noticias matutinas en la estación televisiva de circuito cerrado de la escuela, y quedan inmediatamente atrapados en una intensa competición por captar la mayor cantidad de audiencia.

programme.title: El doctor de la felicidad
programme.desc: Knock es un médico que ve en un pueblo de los Alpes franceses una oportunidad para prosperar.

programme.title: Locas Por El Dinero
programme.desc: Después de que su esposo pierde el trabajo, una ama de casa decide robar la Casa de la Moneda.

programme.title: Balas voladoras
programme.desc: Un detective investiga muertes misteriosas en una fábrica de balas.

programme.title: Un hombre a la altura
programme.desc: Una hermosa abogada recibe una llamada de un hombre que se ha encontrado su móvil.

programme.title: Dejados atrás: El mundo en guerra
programme.desc: El presidente de EE.UU pide a un periodista y sus seguidores que detengan un plan mortal.

programme.title: La leyenda del gigante de la montaña
programme.desc: En esta aventura de la mitología nórdica, Espen "Ash Lad" embarca en una peligrosa aventura.

programme.title: Max Steel
programme.desc: Las aventuras del adolescente Max McGrath y su compañero alienígena, Steel.

programme.title: Infiltrados
programme.desc: Un ladrón herido rechaza cirugía para huir de la policía, desatando un juego psicológico tenso.

programme.title: El duelo final
programme.desc: Una exluchadora regresa a regañadientes a la vida que abandonó para ayudar a su hermana.

programme.title: Muerte bajo cero
programme.desc: Un extraficante de personas encuentra el cuerpo asesinado de su sobrino en un valle remoto. Cuando la policía comienza a investigar el asesinato, se convierte en el principal sospechoso.

programme.title: Amor Asesino
programme.desc: Un asesino serial se enamora de forma inesperada de la mujer que iba a ser su próxima víctima, lo que desencadena un romance imprevisible y peligroso.

programme.title: Miedo silencioso
programme.desc: Sabine busca la verdad detrás de la desaparición de su mejor amiga hace viente años y el anuncio de una reunión escolar pone su vida en una crisis.

programme.title: Beasts Clawing At Straws

programme.title: Scream 4
programme.desc: Sidney Prescott regresa a casa, en Woodsboro. Desafortunadamente, la reaparición de Sidney comporta que también regrese "Ghostface", poniendo en peligro a Sidney, Gale, y Dewey, junto con Jill, sus amigos, y toda la ciudad.

programme.title: El Lobo
programme.desc: En este taquillazo del cine español Mikel Lejarza (Eduardo Noriega), alias "Lobo", fue un agente de los servicios secretos españoles que consiguió infiltrarse en ETA

programme.title: El secreto del lago
programme.desc: Un adolescente descubre un oscuro secreto que desata una peligrosa cadena de acontecimientos.

programme.title: Juerga de mamis
programme.desc: Cuatro madres salen a cenar juntas y terminan viviendo una noche inesperada llena de aventuras.

programme.title: La Mirada
programme.desc: Dramaturga duda entre manipulación y perder la realidad.

programme.title: Viaje a Italia
programme.desc: Steve Coogan y Rob Brydon reciben el encargo de un nuevo viaje gastronómico, esta vez por Italia. Estos dos improbables amigos conducen por todo el país mientras vuelven a discutir sobre la vida, el amor y el cine.

programme.title: New York, I Love You
programme.desc: Siguiendo los pasos del éxito de "Paris, je t'aime" doce directores y varios actores de primera línea toman la ciudad de Nueva York como set y narran diferentes historias de amor.

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: Verano de 1984. Thatcher gobierna y el Sindicato Nacional de Mineros (NUM) ha convocado una huelga. Durante la manifestación del Orgullo Gay en Londres, un grupo de lesbianas y gays se dedica a recaudar fondos para ayudar a las familias de los mineros.

programme.title: Melancolía
programme.desc: Con motivo de su matrimonio, Justine y Michael dan una suntuosa recepción en la casa de la hermana de Justine y de su cuñado. Mientras tanto, el planeta Melancholia se dirige hacia la Tierra.

programme.title: Siempre Alice
programme.desc: Ganadora del Oscar a Mejor Actriz (Julianne Moore), 2014. La doctora Alice Howland es una profesora casada y madre de 3 hijos, no da importancia a los pequeños lapsus hasta que debe comenzar a luchar para seguir siendo Alice.

programme.title: Prisioneros del sol
programme.desc: Una expedición multinacional descubre una ciudad perdida bajo una pirámide en la que tendrán que detener a los dioses del antiguo Egipto que han despertado para iniciar el apocalipsis.

programme.title: El ladrón de Shanghai
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de un maestro en artes marciales, un intrépido joven se hace pasar por un príncipe llegado de un lejano país para poder casarse con la hija del Rey y aspirar al trono.

programme.title: Monter's Battlefield
programme.desc: Ye Qin, la prometida del rey soldado Qin Yang, murió trágicamente frente a una bestia gigante desconocida. Gu Ping lo invitó a participar en la investigación de Ye Qin durante su vida.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: El hermano de un hombre que ha fingido su muerte y robado un monton de dinero de una banda, trata de descubrir la verdad y encontrar a su asesino.

programme.title: Las crónicas de la Grulla Blanca
programme.desc: Para vengar un asesinato, un monje debe cruzar la línea entre la verdadera justicia y la venganza a sangre fría.

programme.title: 12 Hours
programme.desc: Sigue un juego de supervivencia en un mundo virtual similar a Matrix contra varios desafíos, incluido un monstruo aterrador.

programme.title: Ace Bodyguard
programme.desc: Un guardaespaldas de élite "retirado", Zhang Han, une fuerzas con su ex compañero para salvar a su esposa secuestrada.

programme.title: Mentira de familias
programme.desc: Después de que sus padres murieran en lo que parece un accidente de coche, Emily y sus hermanos menores se mudan a un pequeño pueblo de Luisiana. Pronto comienzan a suceder cosas extrañas, dando a los hermanos la sensación de que están siendo observados.

programme.title: El duodécimo hombre
programme.desc: En 1943, en la Noruega ocupada por Alemania, un grupo de saboteadores es traicionado y apresado por las tropas nazis. De los 12 integrantes del comando, sólo uno consigue sobrevivir.

programme.title: Diario de un ejecutivo agresivo
programme.desc: Jack Giamoro, el mejor cazatalentos de Los Ángeles, parece tenerlo todo: una carrera de éxito, dinero y una hermosa mujer. Pero se siente vacío y decide asistir a las clases de creación literaria del pomposo y temperamental sr. Primkin.

programme.title: Bad Investigate
programme.desc: Romeu, un policía corrupto, contrata los servicios de Cid y Alex para atrapar a un notorio delincuente, que salió de México y se dirige a Galicia, España para encontrar al asesino de su hermano.

programme.title: Cómo escapar de Búfalo
programme.desc: Peg es una estafadora que haría cualquier cosa con tal de escapar de Búfalo (Nueva York). Tras meterse en más líos de la cuenta, decide entrar a trabajar en un negocio de cobro de morosos.

programme.title: Los Dalton Contra Lucky Luke
programme.desc: Cuatro torpes hermano intentan impresionar a su criminal madre asaltando un banco.

programme.title: El precio de la fama
programme.desc: Años 70 en Vevey, a orillas del lago Ginebra. Al salir de la cárcel, Eddy Ricaart va a casa de su amigo Osman Bricha. Han acordado que Eddy cuidará de Samira, la hija de Osman, mientras su esposa Noor está ingresada.

programme.title: El viaje del director de recursos humanos
programme.desc: El director de recursos humanos de la mayor panadería de Jerusalén tiene problemas. Se ha separado de su esposa; se ha distanciado de su hija, y está atrapado en un trabajo que le saca de quicio.

programme.title: Mi casa en París
programme.desc: Mathias, un desventurado neoyorquino sin esposa, sin hijos y sin un céntimo, hereda de su padre, con quien no se hablaba, una enorme en casa en París, de la que quiere deshacerse lo antes posible.

programme.title: Dos colgados en Chicago (Los visitantes cruzan el charco)
programme.desc: Thibault, un noble medieval francés y su prometida sufren un terrible contratiempo el mismo día de su boda. Thibault implora a un brujo que le administre la poción que permite viajar en el tiempo y así poder volver atrás para impedir la tragedia acaecida.

programme.title: El archivo corso
programme.desc: Un notario de provincias le encarga un caso aparentemente sencillo: encontrar a Ange Leoni, un hombre corso que ha heredado unas propiedades. Pero, nada más llegar a Córcega, Jack se da cuenta de que el caso es más complicado de lo que había pensado.

programme.title: Entrega especial
programme.desc: Una mujer que se dedica a la mensajería especial recibe el más insólito encargo: deberá recoger a una adolescente rebelde en el domicilio paterno situado en China y entregarla a su madre en Occidente.

programme.title: Distrito 34: Corrupción total
programme.desc: Un asistente del fiscal de distrito trabaja en un caso de asesinato y descrubre un camino de corrupción que lleva a la oficina del fiscal.

programme.title: Fahrenheit 11/9
programme.desc: Michael Moore analiza la política estadounidense y el ascenso de Donald Trump al poder.

programme.desc: Fillers Pluto TV

programme.title: The Ghost Writer
programme.desc: El cineasta Roman Polanski aumenta el suspense en un thriller sobre un escritor (Ewan McGregor) que redacta las memorias de un ex primer ministro (Pierce Brosnan).

programme.title: The Guilty Ones
programme.desc: La hija de BAI fue secuestrada y murió accidentalmente hace diez años, el oficial Chen le prometió atrapar al criminal pero se retiró sin ningún resultado.

programme.title: El detective de Arthur Hailey
programme.desc: Un asesino en serie accede a confesarlo todo, pero sólo si es al detective, antiguo cura, que lo arrestó.

programme.title: El intruso
programme.desc: Tras un trágico accidente, un hombre se convierte en el objetivo de la peligrosa obsesión de otro testigo.

programme.title: Fahrenheit 11/9
programme.desc: Michael Moore analiza la política estadounidense y el ascenso de Donald Trump al poder.

programme.title: Capricornio Uno
programme.desc: El primer viaje a Marte presenciado mundialmente es en realidad un simulacro. Los tres astronautas designados para la misión se ven obligados a participar en la farsa, hasta que un técnico de la NASA decide investigar.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Después de rescatar a dos niños, la ira de Josh se derrama sobre su padre, quien puede haber intentado matarlos. El nuevo inspector desafía la posición de Josh en el equipo.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 2
programme.desc: Cuando dos adolescentes enamorados son perseguidos hasta un tejado y amenazan con suicidarse, Grace asume el cargo de negociadora principal, pero pronto se revela su inexperiencia.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 4
programme.desc: La Unidad de Respuesta Táctica persigue a un criminal que ataca a Grace mientras escapa. Josh permite que lo tomen como rehén. El criminal obliga a Josh a participar en un sádico juego de ruleta rusa.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 5
programme.desc: El equipo de Tactical Response se enfrenta a una situación peligrosa cuando un robo a mano armada se convierte en un asedio con rehenes en un pub suburbano. Lawson y Josh sorprenden a los ladrones y les disparan cuando llegan al pub.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 6
programme.desc: Grace, Josh y Dom están investigando un ataque de activistas en un laboratorio de investigación cuando estallan bombas incendiarias, poniendo en riesgo sus vidas. Stella descubre que su hermano, que también es policía, es corrupto.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 8
programme.desc: Después de que la hija de un político prominente y su amiga de la escuela son secuestradas, Kerry y el equipo de Respuesta Táctica deben realizar una operación encubierta para recuperar a las niñas de manera segura.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 9
programme.desc: Después de interrumpir un robo de autos en Lawson, Stella y Dom descubren un sindicato ilegal de renacimiento de vehículos, pero su sospechoso huye y Lawson lidera una persecución de autos cargada de adrenalina.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 10
programme.desc: Tactical Response es llamado a un edificio de medios donde un hombre descontento se ha encerrado en una habitación y está recitando artículos erróneos publicados por el periódico.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 11
programme.desc: Mientras Grace y Dom se recuperan en el hospital, Lawson y Stella deben lidiar con un exfutbolista suicida, mientras Josh y Michael descubren un misterioso intento de robo.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 12
programme.desc: Una pequeña disputa doméstica suburbana se vuelve desagradable y el esposo huye de la casa dejando a su esposa inconsciente y sangrando. Tactical Response persigue al hombre que está fuertemente armado y es peligroso.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 13
programme.desc: Cuando se llama a Tactical Response para proteger a una figura destacada del inframundo. Kerry sabe que la tarea es casi imposible. El hombre está siendo perseguido por sus socios de la mafia.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 1
programme.desc: Cuando se interrumpe un envío de armas ilegales en una terminal de contenedores, 'Tactical Response' encuentra a un guardia de seguridad herido pegado a un dispositivo explosivo.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 2
programme.desc: Cuando un sindicato de drogas atrae a un grupo de estudiantes para que actúen como mulas, 'Tactical Response' corre para evitar que se vayan antes que exploten los globos de heroína dentro de sus estómagos.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 3
programme.desc: Cuando llaman a 'Tactical Response' debido a una disputa doméstica, Lawson conecta bastante bien con un niño que lucha por cuidar a su padre borracho.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 4
programme.desc: Cuando un padre descontento toma como rehén a un juez de familia, 'Tactical Response' intenta encontrar una solución pacífica.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 5
programme.desc: Durante una extracción celular de rutina, Dom y Stella quedan atrapados en un asedio de prisión. Mientras Shannon negocia con el cabecilla, se pasa de información admitiendo que Dom y Stella están adentro.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 6
programme.desc: ¿Alguna vez has tenido una de esas noches en las que saliste a tomar unas copas con un colega, te hiciste un tatuaje y terminaste en la cama con ese colega? Bueno, bienvenido al mundo de Kerry Vincent.

programme.title: Rush: Capítulo 7
programme.desc: Dos adolescentes que esperan notoriedad en Internet explotan una serie de estaciones de pago de estacionamiento. Josh lidera el esfuerzo para evitar que se maten a sí mismos y a personas inocentes.

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: En una ciudad en las afueras de Melbourne, 'Tactical Response' descubre que un hombre recibió un disparo y un niño fue secuestrado.

programme.title: Gracias a Dios
programme.desc: Alexandre vive en Lyon con su esposa e hijos. Por casualidad, se entera de que el sacerdote que abusó de él cuando era un boy scout sigue trabajando con niños. Se lanza a un combate al que se unen otras víctimas del sacerdote…

programme.title: Corazón Silencioso
programme.desc: Tres generaciones de una familia se reúnen un fin de semana. Las hermanas, Sanne y Heidi, han aceptado que su madre, enferma terminal, quiera poner fin a su vida antes de que su estado empeore.

programme.title: El Taller de escritura
programme.desc: Antoine ha aceptado formar parte de un taller de escritura donde unos jóvenes, como parte de un programa de integración social, deben escribir una novela con la ayuda de Olivia, una conocida escritora.

programme.title: El amor es extraño
programme.desc: Ben y George aprovechan la nueva ley y deciden casarse. De vuelta de la luna de miel, debido al revuelo mediático que generó su matrimonio, despiden a George de su puesto como director del coro de una escuela católica mixta.

programme.title: La caza
programme.desc: Tras un divorcio difícil, Lucas, de cuarenta años, ha conocido a otra mujer, tiene un nuevo trabajo y se dispone a reconstruir la relación con Marcus, su hijo adolescente. Pero algo va mal. Un detalle. Un comentario inocente. Una mentira fortuita.

programme.title: Toni Erdmann
programme.desc: Ines trabaja en una importante empresa alemana con sede en Bucarest. Tiene una vida perfectamente ordenada hasta que Winfried, su padre, llega de improviso y le hace una pregunta inesperada: "¿Eres feliz?"

programme.title: En tránsito
programme.desc: Segunda Guerra Mundial. En Marsella, refugiados de toda Europa embarcan rumbo a América, huyendo de la ocupación nazi. Entre ellos, el joven alemán Georg, suplanta la identidad de un escritor para utilizar su visado, que le garantiza refugio en México.

programme.title: La mujer del chatarrero
programme.desc: Nazif es chatarrero y vive en Bosnia con su mujer Senada y sus dos hijas. Un día, Senada es presa de fuertes dolores y debe ser hospitalizada de urgencia.

programme.title: Tres caras
programme.desc: Dirigida por Jafar Panahi (ganador de la Palma de Oro 2025). En esta película premiada en Cannes (2018). La conocida actriz Behnaz Jafari acude al auxilio de una chica de provincias cuya familia quiere impedirle que siga estudiando.

programme.title: Un asunto real
programme.desc: Osamu y su hijo encuentran a una niña en la calle, aterida de frío. A pesar de sobrevivir con dificultades gracias a pequeños robos, la familia es feliz, hasta que un incidente imprevisto revela un secreto que pone a prueba los lazos que les unen.

programme.title: Los líos de Gray
programme.desc: Gray y Sam (Heather Graham y Tom Cavanagh) son hermanos, pero tan compatibles e inseparables que la gente cree que son pareja.

programme.desc: Al borde de una promoción, una exitosa corredora de bienes raíces, ABBEY, se ve obligada a regresar a su ciudad natal para reparar una casa victoriana heredada de su abuela.

programme.title: Two Lovers
